requirements.title: CAN message 0x1A0 cycle time
requirements.description: The system shall transmit CAN message 0x1A0 every 10ms

requirements.title: EngineSpeed signal range
requirements.description: Signal EngineSpeed shall be within 0 to 8000 rpm
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Signal value never exceeds 8000 or goes below 0

requirements.title: UDS response time
requirements.description: ECU shall respond to diagnostic request 0x7DF within 50ms

requirements.title: BatteryVoltage signal range
requirements.description: Signal BatteryVoltage shall be within 9V to 16V
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Signal value stays within 9.0 to 16.0 V

requirements.title: StatusMessage presence
requirements.description: CAN message 0x2B0 shall be present on the bus
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Message received at least once within 500ms
